idea.title: Feira o guarda-sol
idea.text: feira livre: ele dança embaixo do guarda-sol da barraca de pastel; o topete atravessa o guarda-sol

script.title: Guarda-chuva no topete
script.premise: No ponto de ônibus na chuva, ele dança brega sob a cobertura e abre um guarda-chuva preto, que fica pousado no alto do topete, 25 cm acima da cabeça; a chuva cai no rosto dele, que segue sério.
script.gag_without_sound: o guarda-chuva abre em cima do topete e não protege nada; a chuva cai na cara dele

location.place: ponto de ônibus de avenida com cobertura curta

camera.height: altura do peito, a 4 m, do outro lado da calçada

beats.action: na beira da cobertura, faz o passo brega segurando um guarda-chuva preto fechado na mão direita
beats.extras: pessoas esperando o ônibus olham a rua ou o celular

beats.action: abre o guarda-chuva acima da cabeça; a copa abre e fica apoiada no topo do topete, e a chuva cai no rosto e nos ombros dele

script.end_state: guarda-chuva aberto pousado no alto do topete, chuva molhando o rosto, olhar sério na lente

props.name: guarda-chuva preto
props.orientation: fechado na mão direita apontando para o chão; aberto, a haste vertical e a copa apoiada no topo do topete

script.start_frame: Gersinho na beira da cobertura do ponto, de frente, guarda-chuva preto fechado na mão direita, chuva forte atrás
script.end_frame: guarda-chuva aberto apoiado no topo do topete, gotas no rosto, sério
script.caption: Prioridades.
script.originality_note: primeira piada de clima; mostra que o topete vale mais que ele
script.risks: o guarda-chuva ser aberto acima do topete flutuando; chuva virar slow motion; mãos extras. Conferir G5 e G10.

en.gag_sentence: At a rainy São Paulo bus stop he does his signature brega step and then opens a black umbrella whose canopy comes to rest on top of his rigid pompadour, 25 cm above his head, so the rain falls on his face.
en.location: the edge of a short bus-stop shelter on a São Paulo avenue in heavy rain, wet asphalt reflecting car lights, late afternoon
en.location_map: Center: he stands at the front edge of the shelter roof, half under it. Frame-left: the shelter bench with waiting people. Frame-right: the wet avenue with passing cars. Background: rain falling in visible streaks.
en.position: at the front edge of the shelter, centered, chest square to the lens, the full pompadour and the falling rain behind him visible
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly, right hand holding a closed black umbrella pointing at the ground, feet together
en.extras_tasks: two people on the bench read their phones, one stands looking down the avenue for the bus, one holds a plastic bag over her head and watches the cars
en.props: exactly one black umbrella, closed, held in his right hand, tip pointing at the ground
en.hands: Exactly two hands in frame for him: left hand flat on his belly, right hand on the umbrella handle.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.end_state: same pose, eyes into the lens.

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; the closed umbrella in his right hand swings 10 cm with the hips.
stages.end_state: feet together, umbrella closed, chest square to the lens.

stages.text: He raises the closed umbrella straight up above his head and pushes the runner; the black canopy opens and comes to rest on the top of the pompadour, the shaft vertical, the canopy 25 cm above his head; rain falls past the canopy edge onto his face and shoulders.
stages.end_state: umbrella open, resting on the top of the pompadour, rain on his face.

stages.text: Everything settles and holds; drops run down his cheeks; he stares into the lens. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.end_state: frozen result, readable as a cover.

en.end_change: he holds the open black umbrella by its vertical shaft with his right hand; the canopy rests on the top of the pompadour, 25 cm above his head; rain falls onto his face and shoulders, which are wet; deadpan
en.end_props: exactly one open black umbrella, shaft vertical, canopy resting on the top of the pompadour
en.props_lock: Exactly one black umbrella for the whole clip: closed in his right hand at the start, open on top of the pompadour at the end.
en.lighting: Overcast rainy late afternoon, cool 6500K daylight, wet reflective surfaces, headlights glinting on the asphalt.
